I'm a huge fan of vaping. I've used mostly portable ones and a few stationary vapes. I've owned the MFLB, an Arizer Solo, an Atmos (ugh) and I just got an Arizer Air. I've used Da Buddha, the Extreme Q, the Pax 1 and an Iolite at friend's houses. I've yet to try a Volcano, a Crafty or a Mighty, obviously they are all on my list.

So far, I'm extremely happy with the Air. It's so easy to use and the vapor quality is awesome!

What pieces do you own or have you tried? Which are your faves?
Let's discuss! What vapes have you tried? What are your favorites? Any to avoid?
I like my Epic E-nano. I have no need for stealth or portability so a desktop vape is fine. Adding a bubbler to the mix made it perfect.
Arizer Air is great, Da Buddha is great, the Firewood 2.1 is good, but terrible for more than one person. The Magic Flyte is ehh.

Arizer Solo is the only one I own and my favorite for the price range by far. You can find them on eBay for about $130 USD. The only other vaporizer you can get in that range is the pen type ones like the Atmos Boss (ok, but there are better ones), but the Arizer Solo will blow those out of the water. The only other vaporizer I've personally tried and really loved was the Pax 2 (not the Pax 1, I wasn't a fan of the original one). The problem is that the Pax 2 costs more than twice what the Arizer Solo costs. Seriously though, if you like to taste all the complex smells of your bud, the Solo is my recommendation. If you want something you can use outside though, the Pax 2 or maybe the Arizer Air are easy to hide.
